blocks.html:
In high rise buildings classified in occupancy groups A, B, E, F, H, I, M and S, in low-rise buildings classified in occupancy group B with a gross area of 200,000 square feet (18 581 m 2 ) or more and in buildings classified in occupancy group R-1 or R-2, all other automatically operated cars shall have manual operation capability.
Section BC 3004: Conveying Systems
